title: goeppertia rhizanthoides

It is a terrestrial orchid that blooms underground, producing a single white flower after a period of winter rainfall. The health benefits of Goeppertia rhizanthoides include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and combating infections.
